metrics.label: Goals
metrics.description: Goals scored, averaged over fixtures that were actually played.

metrics.label: Goals conceded
metrics.description: Opponent goals, averaged over fixtures that were actually played.

metrics.label: Interceptions
metrics.description: Opponent passes reached first by this team's defenders.

metrics.label: Shots blocked
metrics.description: Goal-bound strikes whose next touch came from a defender.

metrics.label: Tackles won
metrics.description: Challenges that ended with possession changing to the defending team.

metrics.label: Dribbles
metrics.description: Touches where the same player carried and collected the ball again.

metrics.label: Dribble distance
metrics.description: Ball travel while being carried, measured in pitch units.

metrics.label: Passes completed
metrics.description: Passes that reached a different player on the same team.

metrics.label: Pass distance
metrics.description: Ground covered by completed passes, measured in pitch units.

metrics.label: Shots
metrics.description: Struck kicks whose direction carried the ball toward the goal mouth.

metrics.label: Ball control
metrics.description: Share of played ticks with the ball at a player's feet: inside control range and moving with it.

metrics.label: Attacking territory
metrics.description: Share of played ticks with the ball in the opponent's half.

metrics.label: Fouls
metrics.description: Kickoff encroachments: stepping inside the centre circle while the other side was taking a restart, which sends the offender to the touchline.
